items.rationale: A fixed, permanently wired AC unit is a building component (4.2.2) and was replaced like-for-like after surge damage. This policy has no kitchen-specific exclusion, so it is covered if the surge is lightning-related overvoltage (2.3.3); priced at the reference level.
Labour to fit the replacement unit is an ancillary charge that follows its covered principal item (7.1.11). Priced at the reference level of about 480.
An equivalent replacement of the damaged console the unit stood on is reinstatement, not new equipment (7.1.9 last paragraph). Priced in line with case 38.
Freight is an ancillary charge that follows the covered replacement units (7.1.11). Priced in line with cases 38 and 42.
